description:
Identify measured production consumers and bottlenecks for logical buffers, reductions and bit-layout transforms before selecting kernel changes.

## Background

Population counts, logical row operations and transpose/bitslice conversions can be hidden by dispatch, scratch traffic or unrelated algorithm costs. This profiling-only task provides production attribution independently of external comparator builds.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Satisfy the [Zen 3 measurement contract](dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md) for correctness, reproducible release benchmarks, comparison validity and adoption; receipts pin its committed version, the frozen protocol and the cell addendum. Include mandatory before/after evidence for production changes and preserve negative outcomes.

- [hard] REQ-02: Publish current-code profiles for logical row/parity/dense-matrix consumers, count or fused-reduction consumers, and transpose/bitslice consumers including the current BCH encoding path. Identify actual public-entry-point-to-kernel routes and justify representative input sizes.

- [hard] REQ-03: Quantify time shares, allocations, scratch and conversion traffic, dispatch overhead, dependencies and cache/bandwidth limits. Distinguish compiler spills from intentional scratch buffers and identify where any-nonzero semantics can replace unnecessary full counts.

- [hard] REQ-04: Commit baseline receipts and ranked candidate experiments with family-specific consumer benefit/materiality hypotheses. Preserve not-material findings, and use the current pinned pre-change implementation rather than historical encoder performance as the measured baseline.

- [hard] REQ-05: Limit this issue to profiles and experiment selection. Do not optimize kernels or start an independent BCH decoder/encoder campaign; reuse existing measurement and conversion harnesses.

## Notes

Pin exact source and build identities in the family addendum. Preserve unavailable, incompatible and losing arms rather than substituting a different operation.
title: Profile bit-storage costs in production consumers
